text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: "—Taaahhhhhhh!! —Yaaahhhhhhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Haa... haa—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa... phew.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Good work, Kita-chan. Your times are 
getting better and better.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka-sho was amazing, but... Lately, 
it feels like Kita-chan has grown even 
more formidable.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thanks Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I can feel it myself, too. I truly 
believe I'm getting stronger.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting closer to who I want to be. 
The star of the festival who can make 
everyone smile—!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why! I'm definitely going to 
win next time, Dia-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The Spring Shield is mine. I swear it...!

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: ...! You're amazing, Kitasan Black-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
She's getting faster and faster... By the 
time the Tenno Sho (Spring) arrives, just 
how far will sheâ

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm... becoming stronger, too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Shine. I think maybe... Kita-san 
might've actually been someone I was... 
pretty uncomfortable around.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, o-of course it's not your fault, 
Kita-san! It's just that I—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I end up comparing myself without meaning 
to. ...And feeling down. Because... all I 
can think about are bad things.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Still, you know.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Learn a lot about Kita-san. Learn why that 
girl is... so strong. Learn why she shines 
so brightly.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I respected them, you see.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That Kitasan Black really... really is an 
amazing Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I want to challenge 
Kita-san.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I've finally come to believe in my own 
strength—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The one I respect... I want to go all 
out... and clash against them.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Cheval-chan...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wha... S-Sorry so suddenly, what on 
earth am I rambling on about...?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...Um. I'll... go do some training too."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... Let's both do our best towards the 
Tenno Sho (Spring)... G-Good luck, Shine!

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: ...It's true. You're so cool, Cheval-chan.

And so, the day of the Tenno Sho (Spring) 
had finally arrived—!
(Waaaaaaaahhh--!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, here they come!" "Heeey, good luck 
out there, everyoneee!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Kita-chaaaan, I'm watching you~!” 
“Cheval!! Don't you dare lose!!”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(The voice... Yeah. I can hear it 
clearly.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Kita-san is crazy popular. ...But there 
are people calling for me too.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (I can hear it clearly. Even I can...!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan!! Looking forward to working 
with you today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: —I won't lose!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yeah—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't lose either, Kitasan 
Black...!"
